versions.changelog:
Initial release of RDF Triple Store Integration skill.

- Connects to popular RDF triple stores and any SPARQL 1.1 endpoint.
- Supports executing SPARQL SELECT, CONSTRUCT, ASK, and DESCRIBE queries.
- Enables inserting, updating, and deleting RDF triples.
- Provides management for named graphs and ontology reasoning (OWL, RDFS).
- Supports multi-endpoint federated queries and integration with linked data.
- Offers flexible connection configuration with authentication and request settings.
